weighted_moments_and_quantiles: latitude-band model area weights proportional to cos(latitude); uniform longitude
acceptance_fraction: unweighted count fraction of common-valid spatial samples; >=0.95 below original variable limit
trace_policy: reference <=1e-8 excluded from component relative statistics only, never from absolute statistics
last24h_evaluation: final 24h of the 290-frame window (03-22 00:10 through03-23 00:10); trend additionally reported over03-22 00:00 through03-23 00:00
trend_warning: OLS slopes/p-values descriptive due serial correlation; also six-hour means; not evidence of observational accuracy
height_scope: common native ZG coordinates only, no WGS84 equivalence assumed
pressure_quantity_units: DEN kg/m3; TN K; UN/VN/vector m/s; major constituents mass mixing ratio
